realisticDescription: The question has a natural, credible purpose that a real user could have.
somewhat_realisticDescription: Someone might ask this, but the situation or request feels somewhat forced.
unrealisticDescription: The question lacks a credible use case and feels artificially constructed.
fully_addressesDescription: The answer directly covers the main request and explicit constraints.
partially_addressesDescription: The answer is relevant but misses part of the request or includes off-topic content.
does_not_addressDescription: The answer misunderstands the intent, answers a different question, or misses the core request.
tagline: Helping every answer meet real needs
title: Your judgment makes this evaluation meaningful.
intro: First assess whether the question is realistic, then whether the answer addresses it. Use your own judgment for each rating.
resumeHelp: Use the same code next time to resume your saved progress.
codeHint: Use 3–64 letters (A–Z), numbers, underscores, or hyphens. Codes are case-sensitive.
progressHelp: Progress counts fully rated questions saved to the server.
ratingTipsHelp: Realism: is the question plausible? Relevance: does the answer cover the request?
reviseHelp: You can return to earlier questions, change your ratings, and save again.
completeHelp: Your ratings are saved. You can still return to make changes.
thanks: Thank you for helping us understand the user experience.
q1: Is this a realistic question that a user might ask BadmintonGPT?

answerSkipped: No answer rating is needed. Save to complete this question.
answerGated: Rate the question first, then rate the answer.
